req.title: Task title trimmed of whitespace
req.statement: The system shall trim leading and trailing whitespace from the title on POST /tasks/.

doc.reasoning: The requirement specifies that the system should trim leading and trailing whitespace from the task title when creating a task via the POST /tasks/ endpoint. This behavior needs to be verified through positive, negative, and boundary test cases to ensure robustness and compliance with the requirement.

tests.name: test_create_task_trim_whitespace_positive
preconditions: The FastAPI app is running in test mode.
actions: Send a POST request to /tasks/ with a title containing leading and trailing whitespace.
expected: The returned task title has no leading or trailing whitespace.
tests.executable:
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
from app.main import app

client = TestClient(app)

response = client.post(
    "/tasks/",
    json={"title": "  Task with spaces  ", "description": "A task", "completed": False}
)

assert response.status_code == 201
assert response.json()["title"] == "Task with spaces"

tests.name: test_create_task_empty_title_negative
preconditions: The FastAPI app is running in test mode.
actions: Send a POST request to /tasks/ with an empty title.
expected: The response contains a validation error for the title field.
tests.executable:
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
from app.main import app

client = TestClient(app)

response = client.post(
    "/tasks/",
    json={"title": "", "description": "A task", "completed": False}
)

assert response.status_code == 422
assert "value_error.any_str.min_length" in str(response.json())

tests.name: test_create_task_title_boundary
preconditions: The FastAPI app is running in test mode.
actions: Send a POST request to /tasks/ with a title of exactly 100 characters.
expected: The returned task title matches the input title.
tests.executable:
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
from app.main import app

client = TestClient(app)

max_length_title = "x" * 100
response = client.post(
    "/tasks/",
    json={"title": max_length_title, "description": "A task", "completed": False}
)

assert response.status_code == 201
assert response.json()["title"] == max_length_title
